correctness.rationale: With s=Cy, translating the left endpoint to zero leaves cuts at 1−s and 1; a circle rotation through λ first returns in one step on the outer branches and two on the central branch. For λ=p/q each coset has p+q equally spaced points, exactly floor(q(s+r)) of which are deleted for residue 0≤r<1/q. First return visits all surviving points before returning, so these periods are primitive. Size-weighting the residue lengths and integrating the piecewise-linear slice laws yields the two half-weight endpoints, the stated absolute areas, and the centered second trapezoidal sum for the mean. The normalized weights give the claimed density by Riemann sums. For irrational λ, dense circle orbits induce dense interval orbits, and lifting the invariant measures through the bounded return-time tower gives unique ergodicity. These are fiberwise results with the stated null boundary exceptions. Source verifier inspected but not executed; independent exact direct-cone enumeration checked 1,032 slices for reduced denominators 2–12 and two unequal cotangent pairs, and recovered area and mean. Replay: python3 /workspace/branches/independent_replay.py 2; output /workspace/branches/independent_replay.out.
residual_risks: The finite replay supplements the proof and does not resolve exceptional orbit behavior under alternative boundary assignments.
